about.title: sérendipité clinic
about.subtitle: AESTHETICS WITH CARE.
about.description: sérendipité is a boutique aesthetic medicine studio operating between New York and Tashkent. We combine diagnostics, precision injectables, and soft-care rituals to keep every face individual.
list: • Bespoke journeys: assessment, treatment roadmap, and follow-up care
• International team of physicians and aestheticians practising across Central Asia and the US
• Treatment rooms with medical-grade hygiene and private recovery zones
• Programmes for Tashkent residents and guests: pop-up sessions, training, and quality oversight
about.note: We work by appointment only and support clients in two cities.
about.microcopy: At the heart of the brand is respect for natural features, transparent protocols, and attentive aftercare.

team.title: People of sérendipité
team.lead: Our international physicians, managers, and Tashkent-based artisans guide every client from diagnostics to long-term follow-up.

ceo.name: Dr. Feruza Ashurova
ceo.bio: Founder of sérendipité with 12 years in injectables and device-based medicine. Oversees protocols and personally leads complex cases in New York and Tashkent.

operations.name: Nargiza Yuldasheva
operations.bio: Coordinates schedules, travel logistics, and hospitality for visiting clients. Leads pop-up sessions and aftercare support.

artistry.name: Munisa Karimova
artistry.bio: Board-certified dermatologist focused on soft contouring and biorevitalisation. Mentors the artistry team and quality standards.

skincare.name: Sevara Rakhimova
skincare.bio: Designs post-procedure care plans and trains Tashkent specialists on skin-health protocols.

works.title: Real results of sérendipité
works.lead: Each case is a personalised correction plan that preserves natural features. We capture the starting point, select precise techniques, and monitor every stage.

first.title: Structural correction of the midface
first.description: Subtle replenishment of cheekbone and nasolabial volume to improve support, refresh the gaze, and smooth facial lines without heaviness.

second.title: Balancing the lower third and profile
second.description: Working with lip contour and chin to strengthen the profile and define the oval. Cannula techniques and soft fillers provide a precise finish.

process.title: How we work
process.description: Every session begins with diagnostics and 3D facial assessment. Based on the collected data we craft a personalised protocol, discuss stages and expectations, and document aftercare.

final.title: Movement and natural result
final.description: Short videos show the natural dynamics and glow right after the procedure — no filters or retouching, only daylight.
